mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate signals weakening consumer demand and rising recession risk, which increases discount rates and depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a 3-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals deteriorating demand, which reduces earnings growth and lowers S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling RSAFS and HOUST (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals a tightening cycle, which raises discount rates and reduces S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of FEDFUNDS > 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening economic activity and lower corporate earnings, which reduces S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling INDPRO (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals labor market strength and higher consumer spending, which boosts earnings and increases S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising PAYEMS (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strengthening demand, which boosts earnings and increases S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising RSAFS and HOUST (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) below 2% signals a disinflationary environment, which increases real interest rates and reduces S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of CPIAUCSL < 2% (t-test p > 0.05).
